sentences.text:
As per learned counsel for the applicant, the present applicant is languishing in jail since 27.08.2024 in Case Crime No.0668/2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C.
and Section 5J(ii)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012, at Police Station - Gomti Nagar, District - Lucknow.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has further submitted that the prosecutrix has attained the marriageable age but her age has wrongly been determined as 17 and above.
Applicant has got married with the prosecutrix and with the aforesaid wedlock they are having one infant child.
5. So as to verify the aforesaid fact, presence of the prosecutrix along with the complainant would be required.

6. List on 10th December, 2024.
7.
On that date, the S.H.O., Police Station - Gomti Nagar, District - Lucknow shall ensure presence of the prosecutrix along with the complainant.

8. Learned A.G.A. shall intimate this order to S.H.O., Police Station Gomti Nagar,
District Lucknow for compliance."
In compliance of the aforesaid order, the prosecutrix and her father are present in person.
Sri Vinok Kumar Singh, Additional Inspector and Ms. Shivani Bajpai, Female Constable, P.S. Gomti Nagar District Lucknow have ensured the presence of the aforesaid persons.
The victim/prosecutrix is present in person along with her infant child and has submitted that she is wife of the present applicant and the father of her child is the present applicant.

She has further stated that presently she is living with her parents, but she is willing to live with her husband,
namely, Amit and his family members.

On that, the father of the victim/prosecutrix has stated that he has no objection if she lives with the present applicant, but after release from jail, the applicant will have to come to his place to get his daughter along with the infant child with him and he shall tell his daughter to go with him in front of the relatives of both the sites.
Sri Verma has stated that after release from jail, the applicant shall corporate with the trial proceedings and shall not miss use the liberty of bail.

The learned AGA has submitted that since the First Information Report has been lodged and the charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, the present applicant should participate in the trial proceedings.

Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and having perused the material available on record and also considering the statement of the prosecutrix and her father's and without entering into the merits of the issue, I find it appropriate that the present applicant be released on bail on the following conditions:-

sentences.text: Immediately after release from jail, the present applicant shall go to the place of the parents of the prosecutrix along with his whole family members to get the prosecutrix back in his home and the father of the prosecutrix shall do the needful so that the prosecutrix could live with the applicant properly.
The applicant is directed to look after his wife and his child properly and shall ensure that they are provided all necessary means which are required for any person to live properly.
The present applicant shall get the marriage registered before the registering authority at the earliest, preferably within a period of two months.

Besides the aforesaid conditions, the applicant shall follow the following conditions during the period of bail:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicants fail to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
(v) The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
In case the aforesaid conditions are flouted, liberty is given to the State or the counsel for the prosecutrix/complainant to move an application for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 10.12.2024 Anurag  Amit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7704564/
